messages:
maria: quick proposal — run a cohorted replay to reduce hot-KV rehydrates and avoid large synchronous backfills. idea: split tenants into 6 cohorts, stagger runs across 24h, horizon=7d, low-priority lane during nat off-peak. keeps peak GPU/IO churn down and lets us use soft preemption. ping if this sounds bad
sam: cohorting sounds good. how do we handle dedupe/idempotency? last thing we want is double-counted aggregates or out-of-order writes
jen: +1. we need clear idempotency keys on the replay side. for aggregates we can emit a stable recompute payload and upsert by (tenant, window_start)
lee: console UX note — we should expose cohort assignment + estimated ETA per tenant and a progress bar. teams keep asking "is my tenant in the queue"
alec: routing: when replay jobs hit GPU QPS cap, fallback policy should route to a lighter model variant for non-critical aggregates (e.g., p95 counts ok to use faster quantized). avoid full-fallback unless >= 90% saturation
prashant: also propose a soft quota for replay throughput by org tier. free tiers get micro-batches only, paid gets larger slots. prevents noisy tenants from hogging the backfill pipeline
maria: agree re quotas. proposal: default slot size 100k events, premium slot 1m. slots are preemptible and can be requeued if infra needs capacity
sam: can you share the exact config you'd want to shove into the backfill API? easier to review with a snippet
jen: sample config below — mirrors current backfill worker options but adds cohort and preempt settings:
```
{"cohorts":6, "cohort_window_hours":4, "horizon_days":7, "slot_size_events":100000, "preemptible":true, "dedupe":true, "priority_lane":"low"}
```
lee: minor UX ask: when a tenant is preempted we should show last processed offset + reason in the console so owners can decide to retry or escalate
alec: runtime note — KV cache rehydrate can be avoided for cohorts that have contiguous window hits if we persist last-kv-checkpoint per tenant. that cuts rehydrate time by ~40% in our perf tests
prashant: is there a backstop SLA? what's acceptable delay for enterprise tenants? we need an SLA exemption flag so enterprise replays run in dedicated capacity or get bumped to premium slots
maria: yes — enterprise_exempt boolean that pins to dedicated pool or triggers a manual approval workflow. we should surface cost estimate in console before kick-off
replay-bot: job queued: id=rb_2026_3645001234_cohort3, tenant=acme, slot=100k, ETA=2h30m
sam: nice — can we get a canary run first for a small subset? run against 10 tenants and validate aggregate diffs before full cohort rollout
jen: will add canary flag to the API: `canary=true, canary_sample=10`
lee: once RFC is up pls add screenshots for console changes, and a mock progress bar that shows cohort progress + ETA per tenant
maria: i'll draft RFC today with config, quota table, rollback plan, and console mockups. scheduling a 30-min sync tomorrow to decide canary thresholds and enterprise exemptions. thanks for quick reactions :thumbsup:
